response.sql: WITH phases AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phases) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth) AS avg_selected_bandwidth, COALESCE(SUM(p.telescope_count), 0) AS total_telescope_count, AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - m.mean_bandwidth) AS avg_excess FROM phases AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > m.mean_bandwidth;

assumptions.assumption: A phase with no nonmissing bandwidth values has no defined average and is excluded from the mean of phase averages.
